title: 第6幕战斗吧神选者第7幕手选or随机
content_zh:
第6幕 战斗吧,神选者
(那个……看完了别忘了
“赶紧进来，你们是最后两个了！”
来到门口还没站稳邢辰就被那个资深者一把推了个踉跄，然后又被铁钳般有力的大掌给死死按到了一张破长凳上，“咔嘭”一声震下了不少的灰尘木屑。
邢辰的气力本就不弱，在学校里属于一个干翻俩的那种，被这资深者接二连三的无礼给撩拨的怒气值飙升，虽不敢明着对抗暗中却是牟足劲往上顶着资深者的手试图站起来，怎想仍是被那人压制的纹丝不动。
“嘿嘿，小子，这点力气不够看啊！”那人咧嘴盯着邢辰，满脸的嘲讽。
“估计是强化了力量。”邢辰暗自想着，放弃了和强化过的资深者对抗的念头，然后开口对那人说道，“和你这个资深者比自然是不够看的。”
听到邢辰的话，那资深者脸色一变，随即又恢复了笑脸，道：“小子，不错啊，我看好你，如果能活下来的话我请你喝酒。”
说完那资深者转身便往教堂深处走去，而邢辰也终于有机会打量起眼前的这座教堂来。此时教堂破烂的长凳上已经有两个先到的人在等着了，算上邢辰、女孩和那个叫他进来的凶神恶煞正好是5个人——Dota的配置，这也让邢辰更加确信自己的判断，这所谓的试炼之战根本就是要打一场Dota。
邢辰默默打量着这四人，带自己进来的资深者一身的刺青肌肉和翻边毛刺牛仔装显得痞气十足，凶恶的脸部造型更是让他一眼看上去就知道不是个好招惹的人。
坐在最外面的是一个中学生，穿的是一身肥大丑的校服运动装，书包放在一旁，看起来普普通通没有什么战斗力的样子，而且似乎对周围恐怖片一般的环境很不适应，脸色苍白一直在发抖。
剩下的人看上去是个很普通的男青年，他的表现倒是还算可以，没有被这诡异的气氛影响太多，不过脸色苍白却是避免不了的。
至于和邢辰一起来的女孩，她虽然一直都处在将哭又没哭的临界点上却是对这里的环境一点也不陌生，没有表现出任何的不适应来。
“果然是过来人么。”邢辰心里给女孩下了个评语。
“好了，既然人已经来齐了，那么我就介绍一下状况吧。我的名字不重要，在天神游戏里我们都只用自己的游戏名，你们可以叫我——暗痕。我是你们这一次试炼之战的引路人，也就是那些无限小说里面的资深者。”自我介绍完毕，暗痕环视诸人一周，严肃的问道，“现在，我希望你们非常严肃的回答我一个问题，你们知道Dota这个游戏么？”
邢辰叹了口气，果然一切都和他的判断一样，紧接着，他便首先缓缓举起了手：“我玩过。”
看到邢辰举起了手，暗痕没多说什么，只是冲着邢辰点了点头，然后看向了另外两个先到的人，他们两人表示也都玩过，但是都不怎么精通。
然后暗痕又转向女孩。
“打过一场。”女孩惨然一笑。
“只是一场啊……”暗痕叹了口气，“算了，运气也算是相当的不错了！”

显然，暗痕并没有明白女孩这“一场”的意思，还以为她就是打过一次普通的Dota呢，不过这也不能怪他，毕竟试炼之战都是给那些新人的，像女孩这种特殊状况几乎从来没有出现过。
“不管怎么看这三个人都是菜鸟吧，这个资深者居然说运气不错？”邢辰有些疑惑，换做他反正是绝对不愿意带这种队伍去战斗的。
似乎看出了邢辰的想法，暗痕无奈的朝他耸了耸肩，解释道：“试炼之战本来就是这样，因为毕竟玩Dota的人在人口比例上终归还是少数，社会上不玩的人多得是，有一次我带队还碰上4个完全不懂得，结果自然输了，就活下来一个，害得我只拿到50金基本工资，真是郁闷。”
“等等……你是说这个地方会死人！？”男青年颤抖着声音问道。
暗痕点头说道：“时间不多了，简单的说吧，就是你们被一群爱玩的神选中了。来到这个神造的世界用自己的灵魂打一场Dota，赢了全部活命，继续接下来的游戏，输了，除了发挥最好被评为‘英魂’的人可以幸存之外全部被归为替补玩家！当然，我作为引导者是不被算做在内的，评分只针对你们新人。
此外，每隔6分钟主神会对试炼中的你们进行一次评价，表现最差的那人将会被抹杀，死者的英雄将会由上一次试炼任务的替补玩家接手。
所以，这次试炼之战必然有一些人会死亡，具体是谁我就不知道了，如果你们不想死的话就好好的打！
嗯……如果你们四人之中有人活到了最后却输掉比赛成了替补玩家，那也不用太过担心，你们可以在下一轮的试炼之中替补，赢了就可以获得玩家的正式资格，输了么，自然是抹杀。
好了，废话我也不多说，你们拿出自己刚刚得到的终端，就是那个黑砖头。现在你们可以在那里找到相应的内容，上面有你们能够知道的一切，如果你们活下来回去可以仔细看看，如果你们死了那我说得再多也没用，现在么，你们查看一下自己的任务吧。”
听完暗痕的话，邢辰赶紧拿出那部捡到的手机，果然，屏幕上显示的正是类似于游戏初始菜单的东西，其中“任务”一栏正一闪一闪的亮着黄色的感叹号。
任务名称：试炼之战
任务说明：并非所有进入到天神游戏之中的人都能够成为玩家，良莠不齐的人员素质会影响游戏的水平，试炼之战的目的是为了测试新人的水准，淘汰掉那些不适合者，只有真正有实力或者有运气的玩家才能够通过试炼之战的考验，从而继续他（她）的天神之路。
任务目标：请与你的队友并肩作战并且获得胜利，如果战败，至少成为队伍中得分最多者——英魂，英魂同样可被视为胜利。
获胜奖励：
1：胜利者将会成为天神游戏的正式玩家从而被赋予超越凡人的特权，开启通向天神之路；
2：金币10枚。
失败惩罚：失败者不配获得神的青睐，在每6分钟一次的审判中最差者必然死亡，但是主神又是仁慈的，坚持到最后的失败者将会被列入替补等待第二次机会！
备注：战斗吧，神选者！
content_en:
Act 6 Fight, Chosen Ones
(That... don’t forget it after reading it)
"Come in quickly, you are the last two!"
When he arrived at the door, before he could stand still, Xing Chen was pushed and staggered by the senior man, and then he was pinned down to a broken bench by the powerful palms of iron pliers. A lot of dust and wood chips were shaken down with a "click" sound.
Xing Chen's strength was not weak in the first place, and he was one of the best in school. His anger level soared due to the senior's successive rudeness. Although he did not dare to confront him openly, he pushed up against the senior's hand and tried to stand up. However, he was still suppressed by the man and remained motionless.
"Hey, boy, this little strength is not enough!" The man stared at Xing Chen with a grin on his face, full of ridicule.
"It must have strengthened his strength." Xing Chen thought to himself, gave up the idea of confronting the strengthened senior, and then said to the man, "Of course it's not enough to compare with a senior like you."
After hearing Xing Chen's words, the senior man's expression changed, and then his smile returned and he said: "Boy, that's good. I'm optimistic about you. If you survive, I'll treat you to a drink."
After saying that, the senior man turned around and walked deeper into the church, and Xing Chen finally had the opportunity to look at the church in front of him. At this time, there were two people who had arrived earlier waiting on the tattered benches of the church. Counting Xing Chen, the girl and the ferocious man who called him in, there were exactly 5 people - Dota's configuration. This also made Xing Chen more confident in his judgment. This so-called trial battle was basically a Dota match.
Xing Chen silently looked at the four people. The senior who brought him in looked very ruffian in his tattooed muscles and cuffed burr denim. His ferocious facial shape made it clear at a glance that he was not someone to be trifled with.
Sitting on the outside was a middle school student, wearing a fat and ugly school uniform and sportswear. His schoolbag was placed aside. He looked ordinary and had no fighting ability. He also seemed to be very uncomfortable with the surrounding horror movie-like environment. His face was pale and he was shaking all the time.
The remaining person seemed to be a very ordinary young man. His performance was pretty good and he was not affected too much by the weird atmosphere, but his face was inevitably pale.
As for the girl who came with Xing Chen, although she was always at the critical point of crying but not crying, she was not unfamiliar with the environment here at all and did not show any discomfort.
"It's really someone who has come here." Xing Chen made a mental comment to the girl.
"Okay, now that everyone is here, let me introduce the situation. My name is not important. We all only use our own game names in Tianshen Games. You can call me - Dark Trace. I am your guide in this trial battle, that is, the veteran in those infinite novels." After introducing himself, Dark Trace looked around everyone and asked seriously, "Now, I hope you will answer me a question very seriously. Do you know the game Dota?"
Xing Chen sighed. Sure enough, everything was as expected. Then, he slowly raised his hand: "I've played before."
Seeing Xing Chen raise his hand, Anhen didn't say anything, just nodded to Xing Chen, and then looked at the other two people who arrived first. Both of them said that they had played it before, but they were not very proficient in it.
Then Dark Trace turned to the girl.
"We had a fight." The girl smiled miserably.
"It's just a game..." An Hen sighed, "Forget it, I'm pretty lucky!"
Obviously, Anhen didn't understand what the girl meant by "a game" and thought she had just played an ordinary Dota game. However, he couldn't blame him. After all, trial battles were only for newcomers, and special situations like this for girls almost never happened.
"No matter how you look at these three people, they are all dishonest.Come on, this veteran actually said he was lucky? "Xing Chen was a little confused. He would never be willing to lead such a team to fight.
As if he saw Xing Chen's thoughts, Anhen shrugged helplessly at him and explained: "The trial battle is always like this, because after all, the people who play Dota are still a minority in the population, and there are many people who don't play in society. Once I led a team and met 4 people who didn't know anything about it. Naturally, I lost, and only one survived. As a result, I only received a basic salary of 50 gold. It was really depressing. "
“Wait a minute…you mean people will die in this place! ? "The young man asked with a trembling voice.
An Hen nodded and said: "Time is running out. To put it simply, you have been chosen by a group of fun-loving gods. Come to this world created by God and play a game of Dota with your own soul. If you win, you will stay alive and continue the next game. If you lose, except for the person who performed the best and was rated as a "heroic soul", everyone will be classified as a substitute player! Of course, as a guide, I am not included in the calculation, and the scoring is only for you newcomers.
In addition, the Lord God will evaluate you in the trial every 6 minutes. The person with the worst performance will be wiped out, and the deceased hero will be taken over by the substitute player from the last trial mission.
Therefore, some people are bound to die in this trial battle. I don’t know who they are. If you don’t want to die, just fight hard!
Well...if one of the four of you survives to the end but loses the game and becomes a substitute player, don't worry too much. You can be a substitute in the next round of trials. If you win, you will be officially qualified as a player. If you lose, you will naturally be wiped out.
Okay, I won’t say any more nonsense. You take out the terminal you just got, which is the black brick. Now you can find the corresponding content there. It contains everything you can know. If you survive, you can go back and take a closer look. If you die, it will be useless no matter what I say. Now, you can check your missions. "
After listening to An Hen's words, Xing Chen quickly took out the mobile phone he picked up. Sure enough, what was displayed on the screen was something similar to the game's initial menu, in which the "Task" column was flashing with a yellow exclamation mark.
Mission Name: Trial Battle
Mission description: Not everyone who enters the game of gods can become players. The uneven quality of the players will affect the level of the game. The purpose of the trial battle is to test the level of new players and eliminate those who are not suitable. Only players with real strength or luck can pass the test of the trial battle and continue his or her path to the gods.
Mission goal: Please fight side by side with your teammates and win. If you lose, at least become the one with the most points in the team - the heroic soul. The heroic soul can also be regarded as victory.
Winning reward:
1: The winner will become an official player of the God Game and be given privileges beyond mortals, opening the way to the Gods;
2: 10 gold coins.
Failure penalty: Losers are not worthy of God's favor. The worst one will die in the trial every 6 minutes, but the Lord God is merciful. The loser who persists to the end will be listed as a substitute and wait for a second chance!
Note: Fight, Chosen One!
